definitions.P_sim_force: Share of samples whose simulated settled pad force is at least 4.9 N with no over-force trip. The sensor is ideal (the firmware's filtered true force; no FSR span error, creep or droop) and 0.1 N is allowed [A]. This is NOT the closed-loop true-force R14.
definitions.P_R16: Share of samples whose hold torque is within the part's hold rule (40 % of the sampled cold stall torque). This is the R16 margin: the actuator can supply the hold torque. It does not test the firmware.
definitions.P_R16_sim_force: Both of the above at once.
definitions.R14_true_force_closed_loop: True pad force at least 5.0 N through the hold with the shipped firmware. Not modelled here; measured by the firmware study (see firmware_study).
definitions.t_contact: First millisecond at which the filtered force reaches F_TOUCH (0.5 N). R19 does not name this event.
definitions.t_45: First millisecond at which the true pad force reaches 4.5 N (90 % of the 5 N setpoint). Every close-time number in the note (t_close, P_R19) ends on this event.
definitions.R19_words: Full close in <= 0.75 s. The last 3 deg before contact at <= 20 deg/s to limit impact [A] (ruled DESIGN-BASIS R19, 2026-10-12); selection basis 0.5 s (R19 at selection; superseded 2026-10-12)
definitions.hold_margin: Capacity at the rail low end divided by the hold torque (2 F r_c + T x_f) / eta, capacity = hold rule x stall.

thermal_scaling_estimate.tag: D scaling estimate, not a thermal model
thermal_scaling_estimate.method: SCALING ESTIMATE, not a thermal model. Case and cradle-seat temperature of configuration c at steady state, 5 N hold, from thermal.md's published numbers: the cycle-average heat of the present servo is rescaled by the hold-heat ratio, then multiplied by the K/W that thermal.json implies at 25 and 40 C ambient. Back-off (F1) scales the hold heat by BACKOFF^2 (continuous conduction) or BACKOFF (discontinuous), as thermal.md section 4.4 states. Linear in power, so it understates the rise where copper resistance grows with temperature. current_scale: hold current of c over that of the present servo, relative to the nominal ratio (1.0 = nominal units; the Monte Carlo median currents give a different value), applied as scale^2 (continuous) or scale (discontinuous).

servo_lag_note: Servo lag tau is drawn U(30, 60) ms for every candidate. No candidate row publishes a lag, so a per-candidate lag from listed speed would be invented; the listed speed already limits the slew in the model (w0). What the common draw can hide is bounded by ideal_actuator_R19: a zero-lag, infinite-speed actuator moves first contact by the difference between its row and the shipped servo's.
R12_window_note: Finger stiffness is drawn over the FEA range 1.05-1.24 N/mm, not the R12 window 0.88-1.63 N/mm; mc_at_R12_limits holds one Monte Carlo at each R12 limit.
